ears_text: IF the newest commit on the integration or production branch is a merge commit, THEN the version control system shall require the first line of that commit to have the form "feat (<issue number or -1>): <title>", "impr (<issue number or -1>): <title>" or "fix (<issue number or -1>): <title>".
notes: Narrowed from the catalog's original wording after Gate 2 rejected it as unenforceable (needed the branch type and an issue lookup). Now judges the newest merge commit's subject shape only.
